description: Makefile targets (§19 M2.9, P1): src/generated/{schema,version}.js are file targets built by node scripts from their prerequisites, and src/generated/index.js is a target that depends on both. The generated files are gitignored and loaded by tests; the oracle never runs make, so tests affected through the targets are declared with expect_affected.

mutations.name: prereq-schema
mutations.description: edit a prerequisite of the schema.js target: affects it and the dependent index.js target, not version.js

mutations.name: prereq-version
mutations.description: edit a prerequisite of the version.js target: affects it and index.js, not schema.js

mutations.name: generator-script
mutations.description: edit the recipe's script of the index.js target only

mutations.name: makefile-edit
mutations.description: the Makefile is a config of every target

mutations.name: docs-edit
mutations.description: control: a prerequisite of an unrelated target (docs/index.html)
